annotations.title: Run a script in a headless editor

description:
Run an EditorScript func _run() in a fresh headless editor against the project on disk: batch and project-wide jobs such as re-saving many scenes. It cannot see unsaved edits. For the open scene use summer_run_script.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/run-editor-script"}

checkpoint.description: Take a SummerGit checkpoint before the child editor runs. The result confesses (no_rewind_point) when none could be taken.

max_seconds.description: Time budget in seconds for the child editor (default 120, clamped 15-600). Include boot time — large projects can take 30s+ just to start.

source.description: EditorScript GDScript source with `func _run():`. '@tool' / 'extends EditorScript' are optional — missing lines are prepended and reported in normalizations.

name: summer_run_editor_script
title: Run a script in a headless editor
